scope: R155 additive parent-child span decomposition of MiniMaxH3MLP.forward
conclusion: The decomposition is additive (closure error 0.221 ms) and the activation region between fc1 and fc2 is genuinely 34.717 ms per layer, 1.736 s per step. The SiLU inside it is only 0.575 ms, so the remainder is the multiply, the chunk handling and dispatch.
contradiction_with_microbench: R154 measured the same operator sequence at 3.24 ms standalone, roughly a tenth of the in-model activation region. Since R155 shows the region is real and additive, the extra time is environmental, not arithmetic: in-model the region allocates about 900 MB of FP32 temporaries per layer while the layerwise offloader and its staging buffers are live, whereas the microbench runs in a quiet process.
